အသား ပါသလား၊
ငါးပါသလား။
ဆရာမ အနား
လာသာ လာပါ။
ဘယ်အခါမှာ လသာသလဲ။  --- ညအခါ
ညအခါမှာ ဘာက သာနေသလဲ။  --- လ
လသာတဲ့ ညအခါမှာ ကစားမလား၊ ဘာလုပ်မလဲ။  --- နားမလား
အစားအစာကို ဘယ်လို စားရမလဲ။  --- ဝါးစားပါ
အစားအစာထဲမှာ အသားအပြင် ဘာပါသလဲလို့ မေးထားသလဲ။  --- ငါး
ကစားစရာကို ဘာလုပ်ရမလဲ။  --- ကစားပါ
ဘယ်သူ့ရဲ့ အနားကို လာခိုင်းတာလဲ။  --- ဆရာမ အနား
ဘယ် အခါ ကစားမလဲ။  --- ညအခါ
ဘာကို ဝါးစားရမလဲ။  --- အစာအစား
ဘာကို ကစားရမလဲ။  --- ကစားစရာ
When does the moon shine? --- At night.
What is shining at night? --- The moon.
Will you play on a moonlit night, or what will you do? --- Will you rest?
How should you eat food? --- Chew it.
What is asked to be included in the food besides meat? --- Fish.
What should you do with the toy? --- Play with it.
Who is being called by "Come here, son"? --- The son.
What is the son said to be? --- Someone to rely on.
What is being asked by "Did you get the lesson?"? --- The lesson.
Whose side are they asked to come to? --- Near the teacher.
When will you play? --- At night.
What should it be eaten with? --- Meat and fish.
What should you play with? --- Toys.
